findings.summary: Single selection mode has no role=radio semantics (request still open); matches the accessibility difference measured below.
Home/End keyboard navigation was missing in ToggleGroup; closed.
ToggleGroup outline + spacing=0 renders separated items (Tailwind v4); not exercised by gallery (spacing is default 2).
Accessibility support request for toggle group.
Orientation did not affect keyboard nav; fixed.

notChecked: Reddit, Hacker News and blogs (only GitHub issue search API used)

differences.reference: container role=radiogroup, items role=radio with aria-checked
differences.branch: container role=group, items are plain buttons with aria-pressed (no radio semantics)
differences.how: Inspect first group in #toggle-group on reference vs branch

differences.reference: container tabindex=-1, items disabled with tabindex=-1
differences.branch: first item keeps tabindex=0 and gets aria-disabled=true plus disabled
value is always an array; theme string must be wrapped and unwrapped (mechanical, listed for completeness)

apiChanges: type=single|multiple becomes multiple flag; value/defaultValue become arrays; onValueChange receives array.
DOM attributes data-state=on|off become data-pressed; data-multiple added to group. Nothing in src selects on data-state for items.
notes: Compared on the trial swap: item sizes (46.3x32, 64.5x32, 54.8x32, 38x32, 32x32), background colours and radius identical; real click on the selected item deselects on both; real ArrowRight moves focus only (not selection) and roving tabindex moves identically on both. 390x844 not checked (window resize does not shrink the viewport in this browser); Tab/Shift+Tab ring, Home/End, multiple-mode keyboard and reduced motion not checked. Trial swap was reverted.
reasonNotMoved: Base UI ToggleGroup exposes different accessibility semantics from the Radix reference: single mode is role=group with aria-pressed buttons instead of role=radiogroup/radio with aria-checked, multiple mode is role=group instead of role=toolbar, and the disabled group keeps a tabindex=0 item with aria-disabled where Radix has none. Visuals and mouse/arrow-key behaviour matched. See https://github.com/mui/base-ui/issues/3525 (open). Retry when Base UI offers radio semantics for single mode or the team accepts the screen-reader change.
